title: MemoryArtifact
description: The governed record of one remembered/recalled item as it entered the system from a memory/context provider (e.g. Supermemory). remembered != verified; retrieved != served; profiled != canonical; candidate memory != promoted fact. A MemoryArtifact is ALWAYS a candidate by default and carries NO field that asserts it is a served/canonical fact by itself — promotion to a CanonicalFact happens downstream ONLY through Baltor's VerificationGate + Reconciliation + ConsumptionGate, never here. Carries tenant_id + project/container scope + the upstream external_source_handle + lineage so no memory crosses tenants and every recall is traceable back to its provider id.

artifact_id.description: Content-addressed id (hashlib over normalized content+handle+tenant). Stable; formatting changes must not produce a new id, content changes must.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. No cross-tenant memory leakage; every read is tenant-scoped.

scope.description: Visibility tier. tenant_private/tenant_shared memory NEVER appears on the public /memory page.

container.description: Project/container scope within the tenant (mirrors a provider container/project id). Recall is bounded to a (tenant_id, container).

external_source_handle.description: The upstream id from the memory provider (e.g. a Supermemory memory id). REQUIRED: a recall with no upstream handle has no lineage and cannot be admitted.

claim_status.description: candidate = remembered/retrieved, NOT served. promoted = became a CanonicalFact via the downstream gates (set elsewhere, never by the provider). held_out = preserved but deliberately not served (lossless: held-out != deleted).

content.description: The remembered payload (text/structured). Raw content is preserved; transforms are lossless at the system level and never overwrite this.

provider_id.description: Identity of the providing adapter, e.g. 'supermemory.api@candidate', 'memory.local@v1', 'memory.emulator@v1'.

provenance.description: Provider-side provenance (recall query, score, search_mode, upstream metadata). Never asserts canonical truth.

recalled_at.description: Injected time the recall/write happened (no wall-clock).

parent_artifact_id.description: If this memory derives from another MemoryArtifact, its id (preserved, not collapsed).

source_handles.description: Upstream source handle(s) this memory was extracted from. Preserved for rehydration/rollback.

transform_run.description: Hint/id of the transform run that produced this artifact (lossless distillation: omitted != deleted).

rollback_target.description: Artifact id this can be rolled back to. Preserved so no transform is irreversible.
